tools.name: apis_io_search
tools.description: START HERE. Federated overview of the APIs.io catalog for a query: the top matching APIs, providers, AND tags in one call, each with its total match count. Filter by tags, artifact types, industry, region, rating band. `limit` is per section. To page/sort the full list of ONE type, use find_apis / find_providers / find_tags; for one entity, get_api / get_provider.

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal.

sort.description: Order results. Default: relevance with a query, composite (quality) when browsing. `demand` = Fortune-1000 adoption, scoped to the query.

limit.description: Top matches to return per section (apis/providers/tags).

tools.name: find_apis
tools.description: Paginated, sortable list of APIs across providers — filter by tag, provider, artifact type, industry, region, or rating band. Use apis_io_search first for a cross-type overview.

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal.

pricing.description: Access model — pricing: free, freemium, free-trial, paid, enterprise. (providers only)

onboarding.description: Access model — how to start: open (no key), self-serve, approval. (providers only)

try_now.description: Only providers a developer can start using at no cost right now (free/trial + self-serve/open). (providers only)

public.description: Only providers callable publicly with no signup (onboarding=open). (providers only)

sort.description: Order results. Default: relevance with a query, composite (quality) when browsing. `demand` = Fortune-1000 adoption, scoped to the query.

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

fields.description: Return exactly these top-level keys (overrides view).

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Full detail for one API by aid (provider:api-slug); set include=["content"] to inline artifact bodies.

tools.name: find_providers
tools.description: Paginated, sortable list of providers — filter by text, tag, artifact type, industry, region, rating band, or access model (pricing/onboarding/try_now/public). Use apis_io_search first for a cross-type overview.

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal.

pricing.description: Access model — pricing: free, freemium, free-trial, paid, enterprise. (providers only)

onboarding.description: Access model — how to start: open (no key), self-serve, approval. (providers only)

try_now.description: Only providers a developer can start using at no cost right now (free/trial + self-serve/open). (providers only)

public.description: Only providers callable publicly with no signup (onboarding=open). (providers only)

sort.description: Order results. Default: relevance with a query, composite (quality) when browsing. `demand` = Fortune-1000 adoption, scoped to the query.

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

fields.description: Return exactly these top-level keys (overrides view).

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Full detail for one provider: profile, rating, and the APIs it publishes. The heavy `collections` and `common` sections are omitted by default (their counts are still reported) — pass view=full for the whole document, or fields=["common"] for a section. Narrow for cheap reads: fields=["score"] returns just the rating. Relative artifact URLs are resolved to absolute, fetchable ones.

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

fields.description: Return exactly these top-level keys (slug and name always included); overrides view.

tools.description: Paginated, sortable list of tags in the taxonomy. Use apis_io_search first for a cross-type overview.

sort.description: Order results. Default: relevance with a query, composite (quality) when browsing. `demand` = Fortune-1000 adoption, scoped to the query.

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

fields.description: Return exactly these top-level keys (overrides view).

tools.description: One tag: its metadata, neighbor tags, and a top sample of its providers and APIs (with totals). Use find_apis?tags=slug / find_providers?tags=slug for the full ranked list, or view=full here.

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

limit.description: Top members to show per list.

tools.description: Browse industry verticals; sort by provider/API count.

tools.name: get_industry

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

tools.name: find_regions
tools.description: Browse geographic regions; sort by provider/API count.

tools.name: get_region
tools.description: One region: metadata + a top sample of its member providers (ranked, with the total). Use find_providers?region=slug for the full list, or view=full here.

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

tools.name: find_areas
tools.description: Browse the API Evangelist areas taxonomy (authentication, webhooks, payments, …) — curated, scored provider indexes. Search by text; sort by provider count.

tools.name: get_area
tools.description: One area: metadata, its dedicated site link, and a top sample of member providers (with the total). Use find_providers?area=slug for the full list, or view=full here.

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

tools.name: find_ratings
tools.description: Ranked ratings leaderboard — filter by band, score range, trend, or facet threshold. Sort by composite (default), delta (biggest gainers), or any quality facet (governance, security, …) to rank providers by that dimension.

tools.name: get_provider_rating
tools.description: One provider's full rating breakdown (composite, band, trend, six facets).

tools.name: get_rating_rubric
tools.description: The rubric — bands, facet weights, trend thresholds — so an agent can interpret any score.

tools.name: find_artifacts
tools.description: Find artifacts of ANY one type across the catalog — the cross-type entry point. Each type also has a dedicated find_<type> tool (find_mcp, find_rules, find_scopes, …) with sorts and filters unique to that type; prefer those when you know the type. Types: mcp, skills, rules, arazzo, plans, rate-limits, finops, collections, asyncapis, graphql, json-ld, channels, examples, json-schemas, json-structures, openapis, postman, vocabularies, apis-json. PRO: scopes, security. include=["content"] inlines bodies.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: PRO — Compare 2+ providers side by side: composite/band, per-facet leaders, and an artifact-coverage matrix.

tools.name: gap_analysis
tools.description: PRO — For each provider: high-value artifacts it lacks (MCP, Arazzo, Rules, Skills…), what its peers commonly publish but it lacks, and its score vs the peer median — plus stack-level gaps across the set.

providers.description: Provider slugs (1+). Multiple = treat as a stack.

min_share.description: Peer-share threshold for a gap (0–1, default 0.25).

tools.name: whats_changed
tools.description: PRO — What changed in the catalog since a date: providers added/updated, plus rating movement (up/down) from the latest scoring build.

tools.name: recommend_stack
tools.description: Design an API stack — the best-rated catalog provider per capability, assembled into a stack. FREE preview = the top pick per capability; PRO = alternatives, per-pick artifact gaps, and an exportable APIs.json + Arazzo hint. Decompose the domain into capabilities first, then pass them here.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the stack needs, e.g. ["payments","email","identity","observability"].

region.description: Optional region slug to prefer, e.g. europe.

tools.name: get_provider_artifacts
tools.description: Every artifact a provider publishes — provider-level (MCP, security, scopes, rules, agentic-access) and per-API (OpenAPI, Arazzo, overlays, reference docs) — grouped by type with counts. by_type_counts is the full summary; pass `type` (e.g. OpenAPI, MCP) to scope the artifacts list to one type, since an unfiltered provider can be 250+ entries.

type.description: Return only artifacts of this type (synonym-aware: MCP matches MCPServer).

tools.name: get_api_artifacts
tools.description: One API's artifacts grouped by type (by_type_counts is the full summary); pass `type` to scope the list to one type (synonym-aware: MCP matches MCPServer), include=["content"] to inline the bodies.

type.description: Return only artifacts of this type.

tools.name: get_openapi
tools.description: An API's primary OpenAPI reference (url) — the top agent intent; set include=["content"] to inline the spec body.

tools.name: get_provider_onboarding
tools.description: A getting-started view for a provider — website, portal, signup, docs, authentication, base URLs, and first steps assembled from its registered links.

tools.name: find_similar_providers
tools.description: Providers similar to a given one (alternatives) by shared tags, industry, region, and artifact coverage.

tools.name: find_similar_apis
tools.description: APIs similar to a given one ("more like this") by shared tags.

tools.name: get_industry_leaders
tools.description: PRO — Top-rated providers in an industry vertical.

tools.name: get_region_leaders
tools.description: PRO — Top-rated providers in a region.

tools.name: get_area_leaders
tools.description: PRO — Top-rated providers in a curated API Evangelist area.

tools.name: get_rating_history
tools.description: PRO — A provider's rating movement: current score/band/trend and the implied previous-build point.

tools.name: find_rating_movers
tools.description: PRO — The biggest rating movers (up and down) since the previous scoring build.

tools.name: story_leads
tools.description: OWNER — The weekly "what's worth writing" rollup: ranked story leads from the demand map crossed with rating movement — unmet demand (searched, no result), risers/fallers, and hot-but-thin capabilities. Each lead is a headline, its signal, and a suggested angle. include=["raw"] appends the underlying demand report.

tools.name: export_dataset
tools.description: BUSINESS/license tier — the WHOLE dataset in one pull (not a 100-row page): `ratings` (every rated provider with facets, trend, rubric + provenance) or `providers` (the catalog with coverage + score). For media outlets and analysts licensing the data to publish rankings and trends. Attribute to apis.io and cite the rubric.

co_brand.description: Optional partner name for a co-branded license — stamps the attribution the license carries.

tools.name: industry_gap_analysis
tools.description: PRO — Valuable artifact types (MCP, Arazzo, Rules, Skills…) commonly missing across a whole industry — where the vertical is under-served.

min_share.description: Coverage threshold below which a type counts as an industry gap (0–1, default 0.5).

tools.name: export_stack
tools.description: PRO — Export a designed capability stack as an adoptable APIs.json document (with an Arazzo hint) the team can commit.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the stack needs, e.g. ["payments","email","identity"].

tools.name: find_company_insights
tools.description: Browse profiled companies (Fortune 1000) by name; ranked by overall technology-readiness signal. Free discovery.

tools.name: insights_dimensions
tools.description: Cross-section ranking of the 40 tracked investment dimensions (AI, cloud, governance, security, …) by how many profiled companies show signal. Free.

tools.name: insights_adoption
tools.description: Services, tools, or standards ranked by how many companies adopt them across the profiled set. Free.

tools.name: get_company_insight
tools.description: Full demand-side profile for one company: 40-dimension readiness scores, adopted stack, and per-quarter history. Pro.

tools.name: company_gaps
tools.description: A company's weakest investment dimensions — where it is thin and a vendor could sell in. Pro.

tools.name: match_providers
tools.description: The supply↔demand join: apis.io providers whose product appears in a company's adopted stack, ranked by rating. Pro.

tools.name: find_vcs
tools.description: Find venture-capital firms by name, thesis tags, or category. Each carries a network-matched, rated portfolio graph. Sort by portfolio_on_network (default), portfolio_total, portfolio_rating, or name. Free.

tools.name: get_vc
tools.description: One VC firm: identity, fund facts, and portfolio summary (totals, band distribution, average rating). Pass view=full to inline the whole portfolio. Free.

view.description: summary (default) returns lean discovery records + *_count for dropped sections; full returns the whole record (use get_api / get_provider for one entity).

tools.name: vc_portfolio
tools.description: A VC firm's portfolio companies, each matched to the network and rated. Filter is_provider=true (only API providers), in_network=true, band, or min_score; sort by score (default), api_count, or name. The demand-side view of who a fund has backed. Free.

is_provider.description: Only portfolio companies that publish an API on the network.

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal.

tools.name: find_investors
tools.description: The reverse portfolio edge — which VC firms in the network back a given provider/company (by slug). Free.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Resolve ANY identifier — website URL, domain (stripe.com), or GitHub org (github.com/stripe) — to the apis.io provider it belongs to. Use this when you have a URL, not a slug. Free.

tools.name: enrich_provider
tools.description: One call, pick your field groups — resolves a slug OR any identifier and returns exactly the groups you ask for, instead of chaining get_provider + get_provider_rating + get_provider_artifacts + get_provider_onboarding. Groups: profile, onboarding, artifacts (free); rating, insights (Pro). Free base.

id.description: Provider slug OR any identifier resolve() accepts.

fields.description: Field groups: profile, onboarding, artifacts, rating, security, insights. Default: profile+onboarding+artifacts+rating.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: PRO — Persist the current search criteria as a named saved search you own, so you can re-run it and get net-new results later. Criteria use the same filters as apis_io_search. Requires an apis.io API key.

band.description: Rating bands: exemplar, strong, developing, thin, minimal.

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: PRO — List the saved searches you own (name, criteria, when last run, how many matches are tracked).

tools.name: run_saved_search
tools.description: PRO — Re-run one of your saved searches against the live catalog and return current matching providers.

tools.name: saved_search_net_new
tools.description: PRO — What is NEW for a saved search since you last checked: providers that newly match your criteria. Advances the delta cursor, so each call reports only what changed since the previous call. The agent-native version of the demand report.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: PRO — Delete a saved search you own.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: PRO — Create a named, persistent list (a shortlist / stack you own) of providers or APIs. Requires an apis.io API key.

members.description: Provider slugs and/or aids to seed the list.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: PRO — List the lists/shortlists you own.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: PRO — Get a list you own, with each member resolved to its current name, band, and score.

tools.name: add_to_list
tools.description: PRO — Add providers/APIs (by slug or aid) to one of your lists.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: PRO — Delete a list you own.

tools.name: find_openapis

tools.name: find_asyncapis

tools.name: find_channels
tools.description: AsyncAPI event channels across the catalog. Individual event channels (topics/streams). Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

protocol.description: AsyncAPI version the channel is defined in.

tools.name: find_graphql
tools.description: GraphQL schemas across the catalog. GraphQL type systems. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

tools.name: find_arazzo

tools.name: find_mcp

install_method.description: How the server is delivered: "Hosted endpoint", "GitHub repo", "Documentation link".

tools.name: find_skills

tools.name: find_rules

tools.name: find_scopes
tools.description: OAuth scope catalogs across the catalog. The OAuth scopes an API defines. Pro tier. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

tools.name: find_security
tools.description: Security artifacts across the catalog. Authentication, domain security, VDP, trust center. Pro tier. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

tools.name: find_plans
tools.description: Pricing plans across the catalog. An API's pricing tiers. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

tools.name: find_rate_limits
tools.description: Rate-limit policies across the catalog. Declared throttling policies. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

tools.name: find_finops
tools.description: FinOps / billing models across the catalog. How usage is metered and billed. Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

billing_model.description: Billing model, e.g. subscription, consumption, prepaid.

sort.description: Order: name, or class_count / property_count (largest first).

tools.name: find_json_structures

tools.name: find_postman
